title: AI Visibility Intelligence
description: Track whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews cite your brand, compare competitors, and close citation gaps — your AI Growth Analyst's AI-search readout.
setup_prompt: Use AI Visibility Intelligence for my AI Growth Analyst. With my reconciled traffic data, run my versioned prompt set across selected assistants, track brand citations against competitors with disclosed sampling limits, diagnose citation gaps with evidence, and recommend content and authority changes without manipulation.

setup_inputs.label: Reconciled Growth Data Foundation or equivalent model
Prompt set with personas and locales
Competitor brand set and citation definitions
Minimum freshness, coverage, and confidence policy

recommended_tools.name: AI-visibility tracker CLI or MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Run versioned prompts across assistants and extract brand citations with provenance

recommended_tools.name: Google Search Console MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized queries and pages that corroborate topics worth winning in AI answers

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks workflow database
recommended_tools.purpose: Persist prompt sets, citation snapshots, comparisons, and follow-up outcomes

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether visibility insight explains AI-search presence outcomes
Actionability, measurement cost, and decision value
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge
